patterns.note: Asymmetric two-column layout with a fixed, narrow left sidebar for navigation and a wider, scrolling main content area.
Prominent use of a classic serif font for main headings, paired with a clean sans-serif for body text and navigation, creating a sophisticated contrast.
A restrained palette dominated by a warm off-white background and a deep forest green for primary text and accents.
The left-aligned navigation (logo and menu items) remains fixed in place while the main content area scrolls vertically.
Sections are defined by generous vertical whitespace and subtle background color shifts, rather than strong visual dividers.

technique_notes: Implement a fixed-position element for the left navigation column, allowing the main content area to scroll independently alongside it.
Achieve a sense of spaciousness and hierarchy through abundant vertical and horizontal whitespace, particularly around headings and calls to action.

Use `css-keyframes` for subtle, non-scroll-triggered animations, such as hover states on interactive elements or initial load transitions, as no scroll-triggered animations are evident in the provided sequence.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with generous line height, complemented by smaller, clean sans-serif body text and very small, uppercase sans-serif navigation labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons and input fields have a small, consistent border-radius).
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, especially in the hero section and between major content blocks, creating a sense of calm and focus.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the elegant, asymmetric layout with a fixed left navigation column, combined with an extreme amount of whitespace and a sophisticated, restrained color palette. This creates a highly editorial and premium feel, diverging from typical full-width hero layouts.
